item.text: {"action":"write","arguments_json":"{\"path\":\"work.py\",\"content\":\"\\\"\\\"\\\"Validation and unit conversion for batches of rows.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\nimport math\\n\\n\\ndef evaluate(request, policy):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Validate rows and convert accepted amounts to the base unit.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    errors = []\\n    records = []\\n    seen_ids = set()\\n    unique = policy.get(\\\"unique\\\", False)\\n\\n    for index, row in enumerate(request[\\\"rows\\\"]):\\n        row_id = row.get(\\\"id\\\")\\n        if not isinstance(row_id, str) or not row_id:\\n            errors.append({\\\"row\\\": index, \\\"cause\\\": \\\"id\\\"})\\n            continue\\n\\n        duplicate = unique and row_id in seen_ids\\n        if unique:\\n            seen_ids.add(row_id)\\n\\n        amount = row.get(\\\"amount\\\")\\n        if (\\n            isinstance(amount, bool)\\n            or not isinstance(amount, (int, float))\\n            or not math.isfinite(amount)\\n            or amount < 0\\n        ):\\n            errors.append({\\\"row\\\": index, \\\"cause\\\": \\\"amount\\\"})\\n            continue\\n\\n        unit = row.get(\\\"unit\\\", policy[\\\"base_unit\\\"])\\n        if unit not in policy[\\\"units\\\"]:\\n            errors.append({\\\"row\\\": index, \\\"cause\\\": \\\"unit\\\"})\\n            continue\\n\\n        if duplicate:\\n            errors.append({\\\"row\\\": index, \\\"cause\\\": \\\"duplicate\\\"})\\n            continue\\n\\n        records.append({\\n            \\\"id\\\": row_id,\\n            \\\"amount\\\": amount * policy[\\\"units\\\"][unit],\\n            \\\"unit\\\": policy[\\\"base_unit\\\"],\\n        })\\n\\n    if errors:\\n        records = []\\n    return {\\\"ok\\\": not errors, \\\"records\\\": records, \\\"errors\\\": errors}\\n\"}"}
